copyPolicy: Owner-supplied responsibilities determine service scope. Public project posts and verified visual evidence add project context. Role descriptions explain only the named responsibility; they do not claim sole agency ownership, unverified outcomes, contract terms, headcounts, dates, or budgets. Archive-only projects describe documented features instead of asserting unverified services.

wcdonalds.responsibilityBasis: Owner-provided project role list in the original website brief
wcdonalds.basisNotes: Deck confirms Nick worked on WcDonald’s Anime Dining Experience in Hollywood in March 2024. Agency case study supplies the dining, projection, walk-through, and vending-machine context; the owner brief supplies Nick’s precise responsibilities.

starry.responsibilityBasis: Visual evidence in the supplied project archive; no detailed service credits provided
starry.basisNotes: Photos substantiate the court, branding, participation, spectators, and indoor setting. No date, event name, location, league, fabrication ownership, staffing, or production-management responsibility inferred.

crumbl.responsibilityBasis: Visual evidence in the supplied project archive; no detailed service credits provided
crumbl.basisNotes: HQ archive filenames date photographs to 2023; imagery verifies the mixer, ingredients, cookie box, swings, mailboxes, and corridor displays. The BYU deck describes a separate Edmonton international launch/scavenger hunt in March 2023. That different campaign is not attached to this HQ gallery or story.

sundance.responsibilityBasis: Owner-provided project role list in the original website brief
sundance.basisNotes: Nick’s post identifies the third year of Guru House/Number Project World of Hyatt production, the THR private media space, and program formats. The original brief supplies the 2024–2026 range and the three credited responsibilities.

nascar-billboard.responsibilityBasis: Owner-provided project role list in the original website brief
nascar-billboard.basisNotes: Nick’s post confirms Times Square, the engine replica, pedal interaction, 72andSunny partnership, and Guinness recognition. Owner role list controls scope; no permitting or technical-engineering responsibility is added to Nick’s three credited roles.

stones.responsibilityBasis: Owner-provided project role list in the original website brief
stones.basisNotes: Nick’s post confirms the retired-car conversion, album context, three Chicago activation days, and experiential details. Display Group confirms the fabrication context and gearshift/pedal controls. No responsibility for the campaign film, music, or merchandise design is assigned to Nick.

tictac.responsibilityBasis: Owner-provided project role list in the original website brief
tictac.basisNotes: Nick’s post confirms the mobile sampling tour through Southern colleges, universities and game days, including campus activity, late-night food and tailgates. Exact route, stop counts, attendance, sales and staffing numbers are not supplied and are not invented.

fourloko.basisNotes: Nick’s post confirms 140 sq ft, Guru House/Number Project collaboration, Live Nation circuit, and the listed interactive features. The post’s sales-lift claim is deliberately omitted from website copy; no unsupported attribution of that result to IMMRSV.

keebler.basisNotes: Nick’s post confirms Grand Central, a one-day sampling event, the Hollow Tree Express, cookie-tap interaction, mugs, sound and uniforms. No permit, contractual, fabrication authorship, or attendance claims are added beyond the owner-provided responsibilities.
